# ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN (and ALTER and DROP COLUMN) with a default, limits
# and a message longer than the dictionary record's property field (275 bytes):
# where the original puts the continuations in the dictionary's memo file when
# the table is restructured, and what it frees. The dictionary, de/de.add, is
# kept in fixtures/sql/spddlongalter/:
#
#     run.sh <work> <ace32.dll> spddlongalter.txt > ../../../fixtures/sql/spddlongalter.json
#     cp <work>/data/de/de.a* <work>/data/de/t*.ad* ../../../fixtures/sql/spddlongalter/
ddcreate de\de.add
stmt
direct CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, name CHAR(10))
direct INSERT INTO t1 VALUES (1, 'a')
direct ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN m0 CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN m1 CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE 'mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm'
direct ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN m2 CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE 'mmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmmm'
direct ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN m3 CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN m4 CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct ALTER TABLE t1 ADD COLUMN d1 CHAR(250) DEFAULT 'dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd' CONSTRAINT MINIMUM 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct CREATE TABLE t2 (a INTEGER)
direct ALTER TABLE t2 ADD COLUMN b CHAR(250) DEFAULT 'dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd' CONSTRAINT MINIMUM 'aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa' CONSTRAINT MAXIMUM 'zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz' CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE 'eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee'
direct ALTER TABLE t2 ADD COLUMN c INTEGER CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE '' ADD COLUMN e INTEGER CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct ALTER TABLE t1 DROP COLUMN m3
direct ALTER TABLE t1 DROP COLUMN d1
direct ALTER TABLE t2 ALTER COLUMN c c INTEGER CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct DROP TABLE t2
direct CREATE TABLE te (x INTEGER)
direct ALTER TABLE te ADD COLUMN b CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE '' ADD COLUMN c CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct ALTER TABLE te ADD COLUMN e CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE '' POSITION 2
direct CREATE TABLE tf (x INTEGER)
direct ALTER TABLE tf ADD COLUMN b CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE '' ADD COLUMN c CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE '' ADD COLUMN d CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE ''
direct ALTER TABLE tf ADD COLUMN y INTEGER
direct ALTER TABLE tf ADD COLUMN e CHAR(10) CONSTRAINT ERROR MESSAGE '' POSITION 1
query SELECT * FROM t1
